entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: A long, troubled period of Dominaria's history after the Sylex Blast of 64 AR until about 450 AR, when the Ice Age took hold.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The devastating detonation of 64 AR that shifted Dominaria's climate and began the Dark Age.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The artifact whose detonation devastated Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane in which the Dark Age occurred.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent whose great civilizations disintegrated during the Dark Age.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Proud capital of Argive, consumed by advancing frost.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: A nation whose capital was Penregon.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: A dominant force in Terisiare that preached against artificers' hubris and condemned magic.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war whose great traditions of spellcasting and artifice were suppressed afterward.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The era that fully took hold of the plane around 450 AR.

events.summary: The Golgothian Sylex detonates, dramatically shifting Dominaria's climate with shorter summers, harsher winters and destructive storms.
events.quote: Summers grew shorter, winters harsher, and storms became frequent and destructive.

events.summary: Penregon, capital of Argive, falls to creeping frost.
events.quote: its walls and towers consumed by the creeping advance of frost from the northern ridges of Terisiare

events.summary: The Church of Tal rises to dominance and its zealots wage crusades to eradicate arcane practice.
events.quote: Talite zealots waged crusades to eradicate lingering remnants of arcane practice

events.summary: Clandestine circles of mages secretly preserve fragments of knowledge.
events.quote: clandestine circles of mages continued their studies in secrecy

events.summary: Terisiare fractures into competing tribes, city-states and faiths locked in cycles of betrayal and conquest.
events.quote: The people of Terisiare fractured into competing tribes, city-states, and faiths

relations.note: the age followed the Sylex Blast
relations.quote: that followed the devastating Sylex Blast of 64 AR

relations.note: preached against the destructive hubris of the artificers and condemned magic study
relations.quote: preaching against the destructive hubris of the artificers and condemning the study of magic
